faq.a: Zeynel is associated with the Arabic form زَيْنُ الْعَابِدِين, whose core sense is zeynel; ornament of the worshippers (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Zeynel?
faq.a: Zeynel is associated with Arabic. Zeynel is the Turkish short form of Arabic زَيْنُ الْعَابِدِين (Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn), meaning 'ornament of the worshippers'.
Yes — the underlying form زَيْنُ الْعَابِدِين is Arabic.
Zeynel can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zeynel should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn is a compound of Arabic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Zeynel mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Zeynel is rendered زین العابدین and carries the sense زین العابدین، عبادت کرنے والوں کی زینت.

faq.q: What does Zeynel mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Zeynel is rendered زین‌العابدین and carries the sense زین‌العابدین، زینت عابدان.
A romanized syllable approximation is zey-nel. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Zeynel?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Zeynel, zeynel. Script forms are زين العابدين, زَيْنُ الْعَابِدِين, زین العابدین, زین‌العابدین, ज़ैनुल आबिदीन.

faq.q: Is Zeynel a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
